root_cause.text: The percpu stats for a removed nexthop group entry were freed before the RCU grace period (synchronize_net) completed, allowing RCU readers still accessing the old group to dereference freed percpu memory via nh_grp_entry_stats_inc().
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state that `remove_nh_grp_entry()` calls `free_percpu(nhge->stats)` immediately after `rcu_assign_pointer()` publishes the new group, while the caller `remove_nexthop_from_groups()` runs `synchronize_net()` only after all entries are removed. This ordering gap lets concurrent RCU readers see the old group and use the freed stats. The patch fixes this by deferring `free_percpu()` until after the grace period.
